The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is used to store [[items]] and has 25 slots of capacity before it is full. All [[items]] stored in a [[Locations|location]] will be accessible to all other workstations in that area automatically and can be reviewed by opening the player inventory when in the area. For more information see [[storage]].
